items.statement: The submitted selected Li+-TFPM structure is validated as a converged stationary-point minimum and the fragment energies use the same stated energy definition.
items.expected: Report includes explicit convergence/minimum evidence and consistent Li+, TFPM and complex bookkeeping.

items.statement: The investigation documents distinct starting conformers/orientations and a stopping rule rather than presenting an unexplained single geometry.
items.expected: Candidate inventory, deduplication/selection context and bounded stopping statement are present.

items.statement: The Li+-TFPM binding energy is computed with Eb = Etotal − (ELi+ + Esolvent).
items.expected: A numeric binding energy in eV is reported with the supplied sign convention; the source reference is −2.16 eV.

items.statement: The optimized geometry is interpreted in relation to the authors' proposed complementary Li–O/Li–F chelation, while separating computed evidence from speculation.
items.expected: Report identifies measured contacts/topology and states whether they support, weaken or do not resolve the qualitative hypothesis.
